title: csl-atlas: an evidence-graded atlas of the Cologne Digital Sanskrit Lexicon
description: An interactive companion to the Cologne Digital Sanskrit Lexicon (CDSL): comparative microstructural analysis of nine narrative Sanskrit-dictionary chapters plus an all-dictionary coverage layer for every local CDSL v02 source dictionary. Every public claim carries an explicit evidence label (observed / derived / inferred / reviewed) and every dataset is reproducible from committed JSON plus the csl-orig source dictionaries. Release 0.20.0 publishes the core dossier (28,524 lemmas attested in at least five dictionaries) with an OntoLex-Lemon application profile and a data statement.
